answer: Make each identity run a verifiable delay function every epoch: a chain of squarings seeded by the epoch's cipher that takes about an hour of strictly sequential work and checks in milliseconds. Extra cores cannot speed one chain, so a farm of a thousand fakes must keep a thousand cores busy for an hour, every epoch, a cost that never amortizes. An honest agent spends one core-hour, a small toll, while the sybil swarm burns like a comet tail against onyx sky.
